work.author: Pope John Paul II
work.description: John Paul II's apostolic letter given motu proprio on 2 July 1988 after the episcopal ordinations conferred by Archbishop Marcel Lefebvre on 30 June 1988, declaring the act schismatic, analyzing its root in an incomplete and contradictory notion of Tradition, instituting the Ecclesia Dei Commission, and calling for a wide and generous application of the 1984 directives for use of the 1962 Roman Missal.
